modules.name: Sales & customers
modules.purpose: Turn skills into a clear offer and a useful customer conversation.
modules.task: Write one clear offer for a customer you can help
modules.deliverable: One paragraph naming the customer, problem, service, outcome and enquiry method. Prepare a draft for one existing contact.

modules.name: Marketing & social
modules.purpose: Show useful work consistently and invite the next conversation.
modules.deliverable: A real garment detail or clearly labelled AI concept, a short lesson, and one invitation to visit the website.

modules.name: Brand identity
modules.purpose: Keep Bonga, DONLEGEND and Innovative AI Design recognisable and connected.
modules.task: Align the bio and central link on one account you control
modules.deliverable: Correct display name, relevant bio, consistent contact and the new website link. Confirm ownership before changing a profile.

modules.name: Visibility & SEO
modules.purpose: Help the right people find and understand your fashion and AI work.
modules.task: Check the search and sharing message for the website
modules.deliverable: Review the page title, description, share image, contact path and matched social links. Record any concrete gap.

modules.name: Product discovery
modules.purpose: Turn a customer problem into a small concept worth testing.
modules.task: Sketch one offer or product to test
modules.deliverable: A named customer problem, a small solution, three validation questions and the smallest prototype. Label demand and pricing assumptions as hypotheses.

modules.name: Opportunities & gaps
modules.purpose: Find credible routes to learning, collaboration and commercial growth.
modules.task: Review one fashion or creative opportunity
modules.deliverable: An official source, current deadline, eligibility, relevance and one next step. Leave uncertain fields unknown.

modules.name: AI skills
modules.purpose: Learn tools through practical design work and keep a useful record.
modules.task: Practise one AI workflow on a real design challenge
modules.deliverable: One prompt, the result you reviewed, one improvement and a brief lesson. Record the tool and label AI-generated work.

modules.name: Career & rebuilding
modules.purpose: Reconnect your experience with visible proof and a purposeful next step.
modules.task: Turn one achievement into a short portfolio story
modules.deliverable: The actual brief, your role, what you made and supporting evidence. Connect the lesson to Healing • Learn • Rebuild.
